plain: More than is right or fair, excessive or improper

webster.text: Not due; not yet demandable of right; as a debt, note or bond undue.

more.text: Not agreeable to a rule or standard, or to duty; not proportioned; excessive; as an undue regard to the externals of religion; an undue attachment to forms; an undue rigor in the execution of law.

example.quote: And will not weakness, disorder, an undue distribution of the burdens and calamities of war, an unnecessary and intolerable increase of expense, be its natural and inevitable concomitants?
